We implement enterprise-grade security measures, encryption, and restricted access protocols to prevent unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction of your data.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.content:
Last updated: August 14, 2026

This website uses cookies and similar technologies to ensure technical functioning and analyze traffic to optimize our marketing strategy.

1. What are cookies?
They are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help remember your preferences and understand how you interact with the content.

2. Types of Cookies We Use
- Strictly Necessary Cookies: Essential for basic navigation (e.g., maintaining the selected language).
- Performance and Analytics Cookies: Used (via tools like Google Analytics) to count visits, traffic sources, and improve site performance. They are anonymous.
- Marketing Cookies: Used to track the effectiveness of our B2B campaigns and offer relevant content.

3. Cookie Control
You can configure your browser at any time to totally or partially reject the installation of cookies, although this could affect the user experience on the platform.
